تختلقن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِقْنَ (taḵtaliqna) /tax.ta.liq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# تُخْتَلَقْنَ (tuḵtalaqna) /tux.ta.laq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
